verdict.rationale: Databricks stores data in the open Delta Lake/Parquet format and offers Delta Sharing (OpenSharing) to share or export data outside the organization regardless of platform, plus CLI/SDK/REST API access for programmatic extraction of data and metadata. However, there's no single documented 'export everything and leave' workflow or bulk account-export tool, and community commentary (e.g., migrating workloads to Postgres) suggests migration is done piecemeal rather than via a turnkey export feature. missing for 10: a dedicated full-account/bulk data export or migration tool, and independent hands-on confirmation of frictionless full data egress.
